results.prop: P2B1 per-step soundness of the P2 test: a positive cr_margin, the navigation error inside (e_h, e_h, e_z) and the true displacement inside the per-axis reach keep the true centre out of the CR
results.formula: sep_k(q, R, err, slack) & |e| <= err & -R- <= x <= R+ -> not inside_CR(q + e + x)
results.note: e_h 1.0 m, e_z 1.0 m, slack 0.05 m; the command of a step is applied for dt = 0.1 s <= tau_c = 0.35 s, inside the first phase of its own backup

results.prop: P2B1r the deployed axis_reach does not under-estimate the exact maximum of the envelope integral (numeric, dense grid)
results.formula: forall (u0, u) in grid: axis_reach >= exact - err_kinks, err_kinks < SLACK_M
results.note: 14641 pairs per side, |u| <= 0.6 m/s; largest under-estimate 5.74e-05 m at (-0.6, 0.56, '+'); analytic bound of the trapezoidal/sampling error (4 kinks, a h^2 / 8, h = 0.0323 s) 2.61e-04 m; SLACK_M 0.05 m

results.prop: P2B2 recursive feasibility of the one-step margin: a command P2-safe with one-step margin above Delta = 0.179 m leaves braking P2-safe at the next step; holding at the stage-2 target (margin 0.100 m) stays P2-safe while the realised drift of a step is within its bound (numeric, grid)
results.formula: forall grid (u0, u): x(dt) + R(v(dt), 0) + delta_e - R(u0, u) <= Delta; hold margin > Delta_hold
results.note: 7442 cases, |u| <= 0.6 m/s, dt 0.1 s; worst Delta 0.179 m at (u0, u, side) (-0.6, -0.6, '+') (a fast motion away from that side: the envelope lets it stop at once at the next step); worst Delta when neither the velocity nor the command points away 0.029 m, with |u0|, |u| <= 0.3 m/s 0.104 m; Delta of a hold 0.029 m (drift w dt + change of the navigation error 0.0136 m per step from the NavBound coefficients).  This describes the ONE-STEP margin (cr_margin without lookahead); the deployed selection uses the robust margin (P2B5) and the anchored station keeping (P2B4)

results.prop: P2B2s scope: strict invariance of the one-step P2-safe set fails (one-step margin > 0 does not imply a P2-safe braking at the next step): the latency phase and its drift are applied again at every step
results.formula: expect a grid case with x(dt) + R(v(dt), 0) > R(u0, u)
results.note: 4438 of 7442 cases with a positive deficit, worst 0.179 m at (-0.6, -0.6, '+'): a command chosen on its one-step margin below it may leave no P2-safe command at the next step.  The deployed selection therefore uses the robust margin (P2B5: braking stays P2-safe from every worst-case state after dt) and the anchored station keeping (P2B4)

results.prop: P2B3 adversarial trajectories: no command called P2-safe by the deployed filter lets a true trajectory inside the declared envelope into the CR (numeric)
results.formula: forall sampled (q, v0, u) with margin > 0 and admissible profiles: true centre not in CR
results.note: 21850 trajectories (1500 states near the CR, up to 5 P2-safe candidate commands each, 8 extreme per-axis combinations at the error corners + 2 random), sampled every 10 ms; 0 entered the CR

results.prop: P2B4 station keeping on a latched anchor: over the states of the unsaturated position loop (deviation within e_track, the loop velocity at that deviation plus the drift) the margin equals that of the anchor (time-invariant), and with the measured velocity within v_err it stays positive at the stage-2 target (numeric)
results.formula: forall anchors, |e_k| <= e_track, v = k (a - q) + d: hold_margin(q, v) = hold_margin(a, 0); with v_err: hold_margin > 0 at the stage-2 target
results.note: 101250 loop states, 5 anchors (stage-2 target, beside, above, below, beyond the gate), gains 0.5 / 0.6, cap 0.27 m/s, drift +-0.15 per axis; exact invariance with the true velocity: largest drop 0.00e+00 m.  With the measured velocity within v_err 0.098 m/s (DVL 3 sigma) the braking term of hold_margin can exceed the anchor term at the edge of the deviation band: largest drop 0.083 m at ([-2.5525, 0.0, 0.0], [0.3, -0.3, -0.3], [0.098, 0.098, 0.098]): the margin RECOMPUTED onboard at a later step is time-invariant only up to that amount (R-c: a fresh measurement inflation), which is why the certificate of station keeping is the one latched when the maneuver is engaged (gate_safety.P2Certificate; P2R3, P2R4): continuing it needs no re-certification; stage-2 target margin min 0.017 m.  0 deviation/gain cases saturate the per-axis cap HOLD_V_MAX (> w: still restoring on every axis, P2R3a; the former 2-norm cap needed the drift vector below HOLD_V_MAX).  Deviation and velocity taken independently (states the loop does not produce): min -0.165 m

results.prop: P2B5 robust selection: every command returned by the deployed warning filter, escape (station-keeping HOLD) or filter_mission with a positive robust margin leaves station keeping on the next estimate P2-safe from every worst-case state after dt (numeric, grid)
results.formula: forall returned u with robust margin > 0, corners of the state after dt and of the next estimate: SK margin from the true velocity > 0
results.note: 4948 returned commands (63 threat sets x 2 planners, 9 mission commands; 16 positions x 4 velocities; HOLD answers are station keeping, P2B4 / P2R3); v_err 0.098 m/s, rho 0.142 m/s; worst next-step SK margin 0.053 m, computed independently of next_band (upper_at, side_end); 0 failures.  The certificate is handed to the next step, not recomputed there (P2R2, P2R4n); the old target of this check - braking re-certified onboard at the next step - is the counterexample P2R2m

results.prop: P2R1 the closed-form braking reach X(a0) = a0+^2 / (2 a_brake) + w T, T = max(tau_c, a0+ / a_brake), is non-decreasing in the upper velocity a0 (for all reals)
results.note: a_brake 0.5, w 0.15, tau_c 0.35: the onboard upper bounds of the next step (a larger velocity) never give a smaller reach (used by P2R2, P2R5)

results.prop: P2R1x the closed-form X is the maximum over [0, T] of the displacement under the zero-command envelope max(0, a0 - a_brake t) plus the drift w, and is reached at T (the envelope is at rest from T on)
results.note: x(t) the integral of the envelope in closed form (piecewise quadratic): the running maximum is the end value (integrand >= w > 0)

results.prop: P2R1n the deployed gate_safety.brake_reach equals the closed form and a dense integration of the envelope (numeric)
results.formula: forall a0 in grid: |brake_reach - closed| , |brake_reach - integral| < 1e-6
results.note: 641 velocities in [-1.6, 1.6] m/s, 4000 trapezoids each; largest difference 4.7e-10 m

results.prop: P2R2 onboard-consistent lookahead: from every state after dt consistent with the bounds (true displacement <= xp, true velocity <= vp, next estimate within rho dt of the true displacement), the band of station keeping engaged at the next step on the next estimate is inside the band of the deployed lookahead
results.formula: x <= xp & v1 <= vp & |dq| <= rho dt -> max(q1 + X(v1) + rho T(v1), q1 + H) <= q + xp + rho dt + max(X(vp) + rho T(vp), H), q1 = q + x + dq
results.note: for all reals q, x, xp, v1, vp and every rho >= 0; H = e_track + w tau_c = 0.3525 m; the - side is the + side of the mirrored axis.  With the CR separation of P2R3d it gives: robust margin > 0 at step k -> station keeping on the next estimate certified at k + 1 (kind NEXT), with no use of the next measurement (the 2 v_err inflation of a re-certification is not needed)

results.prop: P2R2w witness: the premises of P2R2 are satisfiable with the deployed band attained (non-vacuous, tight at x = xp, v1 = vp, dq = rho dt)
results.formula: exists a state with the premises and band_next = deployed

results.prop: P2R2n the deployed robust margin (cr_margin lookahead, next_band) is min(one-step margin, the lookahead band of P2R2) computed independently (numeric)
results.formula: forall sampled (q, v0, u): |deployed - min(m1, m2_independent)| < 1e-6
results.note: 4000 random states and commands (|v| <= 0.6 m/s), v_err 0.098, rho 0.142 m/s; the state after dt by the exact pieces of check_gate_safety.upper_at; largest difference 8.9e-16 m

results.prop: P2R3a station-keeping band, q-loop (premise H on the estimate): every per-axis restoring loop of gain in [K_HOLD, 1/dt], capped per axis at >= HOLD_V_MAX, keeps the deviation of the estimate inside any band [-Dm, Dp] with Dm, Dp >= e_track against the residual drift (sampled loop; inductive invariant)
results.formula: -Dm <= d <= Dp & |w_k| <= w -> -Dm <= d + dt (-sat(g d) + w_k) <= Dp
results.note: K_HOLD 0.5, HOLD_V_MAX 0.27 > w 0.15, dt 0.1; covers hold_velocity (gain K_HOLD, per-axis cap) and the unsaturated loops of the flows (gain k_track 0.6); the band of sk_band has half widths >= e_track + w tau_c (the latency allowance: premise H, P2R3n); base case: the loop starts inside the band by construction (q + X + rho T, P2R1)

results.prop: P2R3b a horizontal loop capped in 2-norm at c_h stays unsaturated inside a latchable band (gate_safety.latchable: g |D_h| <= c_h), so P2R3a applies to it on s and l
results.note: the stage-2 hold / standoff (k_track, v_pass) and the failsafe hold (0.5, 0.25 m/s) of Flows; a loop that is not latchable is replaced by hold_velocity on its anchor (filter_mission)

results.prop: P2R3c station-keeping band, p-loop (the TRUE motion follows the command up to the drift): hold_velocity on the estimate q = p - e, |e| <= E, keeps the true deviation p - a inside any band |p - a| <= D with D >= E + e_track (per-axis cap: every axis restoring whatever the others)
results.formula: |p| <= D & |e| <= E & |w_k| <= w -> |p + dt (clip(K (e - p), +-HOLD_V_MAX) + w_k)| <= D
results.note: the band of hold_margin in true coordinates is max(p_s - a, E + e_track) + the latency allowance: the deployed band (+ rho T) contains it, so the per-axis capped law is certified under either reading of premise H; a 2-norm cap is not (an axis with a small deviation may lose its restoring component when the estimate deviation is large)

results.prop: P2R3d a positive station-keeping margin keeps the true centre out of the CR column: during the braking (true displacement <= X, P2R1x) and in the loop (estimate inside the band, P2R3a / P2R3b, truth within E of it)
results.formula: cr_lo - (max(q0 + X + rho T, a + H) + E + slack) > 0 -> p(t) < cr_lo
results.note: separation along one axis towards its + side (s or l, either side by mirroring), as P2B1

results.prop: P2R3n sampled closed loop of station keeping (hold_velocity) with the latency, the velocity lag, adversarial drift and estimate error inside the premises: no start certified by hold_margin lets the true centre reach the CR column (numeric)
results.formula: forall sampled certified starts and adversarial modes: true (s, l) extremes separated from the CR
results.note: 596 certified starts (random states before the CR with |v| <= 0.6 m/s, the stage-2 hold with the measured velocity at +-v_err), true velocity at the measured one +- v_err, the estimate error at +-E, 9 drift / error modes, 21456 closed loops of 40 s at 10 ms, command every 0.1 s from data 0.25 s old; 0 reached the column; smallest separation of the true extremes 0.203 m (conservative: extremes of s and l taken independently).  Latency allowance of premise H: from the stage-2 hold at rest the true deviation from the anchor exceeded E + e_track by at most -0.0000 m (allowance w tau_c = 0.0525 m)

results.prop: P2R5 base case: station keeping on the estimate is certified at every state whose column separation along s or l is at least D_base = 2.154 m, for every measured speed per axis up to v_bound 0.70 m/s (fresh DVL)
results.formula: q <= cr_lo - D_base & |vm| <= v_bound -> hi_SK(q, vm) + E + slack < cr_lo
results.note: v_err 0.098 m/s, rho 0.142 m/s.  Activation (reported): the constraint becomes active within ACTIVE_RANGE_M = 8.0 m of the CR box (3-D) and was inactive one step earlier, so at activation the distance is >= 7.92 m; the depth envelope of the arena (-9.0 to -1.5 m) bounds the vertical offset from the CR box by 5.5 m, so the larger of the s / l separations is >= 4.03 m (>= D_base): the base case holds on entering the range.  During a DVL outage (v_err = v_bound) D_base = 5.51 m (not covered at activation).  A gate that becomes the current one while the drone is already inside the range (consecutive gates nearer than the range) is outside this base case

results.prop: P2R4 recursive availability (induction step): a certified command at step k and the premises at k + 1 leave a certified command applied at k + 1 and the true centre out of the column: the certified set is never empty and P2_UNCERTIFIED is never logged while the declared bounds hold
results.formula: (next_k | sk_k) & prem_{k+1} & axioms -> (next_{k+1} | sk_{k+1}) & safe_{k+1}
results.note: axioms: the selection rule (a certified command is applied whenever one exists: checked numerically by J1 and P2R4n, not proved), P2R2 (NEXT -> SK on the next estimate certified), P2R3a-d (a latched SK stays certified, the true centre out of the column), P2B1 (a robust command keeps the control interval out of the column), P2R5 (base).  Premises per step: N, V, D (no position correction: the controller drops the certificates), the envelope, H, the same gate, rho not raised during a braking phase (a DVL outage onset can break the step: declared limit); base case: unsat

results.prop: P2R4l declared limit: the induction step needs its premises at the next step; a DVL outage that begins before a handed certificate is used (v_err and rho raised to the outage bounds) or a position correction (the certificates are dropped) can leave no certified action: the controller then logs P2_UNCERTIFIED and retreats (P2_RECOVERY)
results.formula: expect a state with a NEXT certificate whose next step is uncertified in an outage and after a correction, and certified otherwise
results.note: fresh v_err 0.098 / rho 0.142 m/s, outage 0.700 / 0.744 m/s; robust command (0.5 m/s along the axis, 2.0 m before the CR entry plane), worst next state: with the handed certificate station keeping is certified (JOINTLY_FEASIBLE), without it (correction) or with the outage bounds the filter retreats (P2_RECOVERY, P2_RECOVERY).  Not resolved: the next measurement regime cannot be anticipated without making every command certify the outage bounds; tests/test_gate_aware_avoidance.py keeps the outage-at-the-hold retreat

results.prop: P2R4n every command returned with a positive robust margin (warning filter, escape with the HOLD, filter_mission) leaves, at every worst-case next state, a certified station keeping to the deployed next-step constraint (numeric, grid of P2B5)
results.formula: forall returned u, corners (side, estimate drift +-rho dt, measurement +-v_err): sk_certificate(q1, NEXT) is not None
results.note: 4948 returned commands, 118752 next states (8 side corners x 3 drift / measurement corners); 0 without a certified action; 64 of the next states rely on the handed certificate (the SK margin recomputed with the fresh measurement is not positive: the R-c drop), 5824 have no onboard-certified braking (one-step margin of a zero command, the braking lookahead); smallest handed margin 0.003 m

results.prop: P2R2m mutation: the braking lookahead (braking from the true worst-case state after dt, re-certified at the next step with the fresh measurement) leaves next states where no braking is certified onboard although braking is physically safe: the counterexample of that recursive argument, kept as a witness
results.formula: expect returned commands with an onboard braking margin <= 0 at a next-state corner
results.note: 4772 commands returned by the planners with the robust margin and the hold_margin of the braking lookahead; 744 with a next-state corner whose onboard braking (velocity measured within v_err and filtered with it) is not certified (744 of 4772 at a9ffa34 with the former CR), 0 physically unsafe; onboard deficit min -0.114 m, median -0.009 m.  Root cause (R-a): the braking lookahead took the next velocity as the true worst case vp, the onboard re-certification uses up to vp + 2 v_err and the next estimate moves by up to rho dt more

results.prop: P2B6 the CR column: no command called P2-safe lets a true trajectory inside the declared envelope pass under or over the CR (cr_s_min <= s <= cr_s_max, |l| <= cr_half_width at any depth; numeric)
results.formula: forall sampled (q above or below the CR, v0, u) with robust margin > 0: true (s, l) never in the CR footprint
results.note: 10200 trajectories from 900 states 1-4 m above or below the CR centre (extreme s, l profiles at the error corners and random ones, any vertical profile); 0 reached the column

results.prop: P2B6m mutation: with the forbidden set the CR box (column=False) commands called safe let the drone pass under or over the CR
results.formula: expect a sampled trajectory inside the CR footprint
